name: What To Wear
overview: Scripture instructs believers to maintain distinctions in their attire, forbidding garments made of mixed materials such as linen and wool, and clearly prohibiting cross-dressing as it is considered an abomination to the Lord. True beauty and favor come not from outward appearance but from a reverent fear of God. While God encourages trust in His provision rather than anxiety over clothing, believers are also called to put off their former corrupt ways, reflecting holiness in all aspects of life, including what they wear.
